how.step1: Pick one or two units and the difficulty.
how.step2: Solve it on the whiteboard, calculator at hand.
how.step3: Check the answer and the step-by-step solution.

about.title: About
about.intro: Mathestudiatics is a personal, bilingual, open-source platform to study math from any device.

content.title: Content and anonymity
content.body: Study material is rewritten in our own words and without identifying data: no personal names, institutions or original material are published.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no servers: study data stays on your device.
